rules.source: Data Protection Act, Act No. 18 of 2024 — https://cipit.org/?p=3218
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: enacted 29 October 2024, repealing the never-commenced 2018 Act; continues the Information and Data Protection Commission with independence and expanded powers; commencement reported as 14 January 2025 (one source says 29 October 2024); commentary notes breach notification timelines, DPIAs for high-risk processing and rules on children's data.
